name: @nexartis/homeport-sdk
description: Official TypeScript SDK for Homeport — the open-source, self-hostable NANDA node from Nexartis. Register agents, run A2A discovery and trust scoring, orchestrate DAG workflows, and resolve the NANDA Index (Project NANDA, MIT Media Lab).

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run docs:stage && pnpm run docs-site:install && pnpm --dir typedoc-site run test:e2e
scripts.prepack: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
scripts.docs:stage: pnpm run docs && mkdir -p typedoc-site/dist && cp -R typedoc-site/public/. typedoc-site/dist/
scripts.validate: pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run docs && pnpm run size
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:stage && pnpm run docs-site:install && cd typedoc-site && pnpm run deploy:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:stage && pnpm run docs-site:install && cd typedoc-site && pnpm run deploy:prod

author: Nexartis, LLC
